versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the **clinical-case-summary** skill for generating structured clinical case summaries.
- Supports SBAR and SOAP formats for use in case presentations, handovers, case reports, or educational summaries.
- Incorporates detailed input requirements: patient background, complaint, history, examination, investigations, diagnosis, management, and outcome.
- Includes guidance on anonymisation, inclusion of allergies/medications, and clinical safety netting.
- Provides clear quality checks and anti-patterns to ensure summaries are appropriate for documentation and education.
- Prominently features a clinical disclaimer: for educational and documentation purposes only—not clinical advice.
